job.job_description:
Moveworks AI Engineer Enterprise AI Automation




Experience: 4+ years

Location: Chennai, India

Role Type: Full-Time




About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Moveworks AI Engineer to build and deploy enterprise AI agents, plugins, workflows, and integrations. This is primarily a development-focused role (80%), with some platform administration, governance, and production support responsibilities (20%).




Key Responsibilities

Design, build, test and deploy Moveworks Agent Studio plugins, workflows, agents, and conversational experiences.
Develop REST API integrations, including JSON, OAuth/authentication, webhooks, data mapping, and error handling.
Build enterprise automation across platforms such as ServiceNow, Workday, Nextthink, Jira, or Zendesk.
Develop automation for ITSM, HR self-service, endpoint support, knowledge discovery, and employee workflows.
Configure conversation flows, triggers, activities, decision logic, confirmations, and access-aware responses.
Troubleshoot production issues involving APIs, integrations, workflows, access, and bot responses.
Work with business and technical stakeholders to convert requirements into production-ready AI automations.
Support testing, UAT, releases, documentation, and continuous improvement.



Must-Have Skills

Hands-on Moveworks Agent Studio experience with evidence of building plugins/workflows, not just platform administration.
Strong REST API / JSON / OAuth / Webhooks integration experience.
Experience with at least one enterprise workflow platform such as ServiceNow, Workday, Nextthink, Jira or Zendesk.
Scripting experience in Python, JavaScript, or PowerShell.
Experience taking integrations/automations through development testing production.
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.



Good to Have

Nexthink, Snowflake, or Power BI
Microsoft Teams/bot deployment
Microsoft Entra ID / SSO / RBAC
LLM and RAG concepts
Moveworks, ServiceNow, or Microsoft Copilot Studio certification
Experience with enterprise AI assistants, chatbots, or automation platforms.
